verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is a hardware product; its accompanying ROCm software stack is described as 'primarily open-source' and inspectable/customizable, but the evidence never links to an actual source repository, and 'primarily' implies parts (drivers, firmware, hardware design) remain closed. Missing for 10: direct links to open-source repositories/license text, confirmation of which components are open vs proprietary, and any hardware design openness.
